NCC Education awards the Level 3, Level 4 and Level 5 qualifications. The final Bachelor’s degree is validated and awarded by the University of Greater Manchester, and the top-up programme is delivered online by Western International College Online (WINC). IIHE Cambodia is accredited by NCC Education, not by the university.

q: Is progression to the Bachelor’s degree guaranteed?
a: NCC Education’s university progression partnership provides a guaranteed route to the final Bachelor’s stage for students who successfully complete Level 5 and meet the published entry requirements. Our admissions team will explain the conditions before you enrol.

q: Do I need to leave Cambodia?
a: No. You complete the NCC Education stages at IIHE Cambodia and the final degree stage online. You can remain in Cambodia for the full pathway.

q: How long does the full pathway take?
a: The standard route takes four academic years from Foundation to the final Bachelor’s degree stage. Your starting level may be different if you already hold a recognised qualification.
